item.title: Fire Risk, bad Odour and Fox Droppings, 30th October
item.description:
Yesterday, a man arrived at this property, he took out allot of rubbish, a fridge, mattresses and put all of it facing the street. See pictures. The Fox are going through the rubbish at night, the wind carries some of it all around, leaving those mattresses and papers feel like it’s a fire hazard, the rubbish that spills onto the street feels as if it can blocks a person right of way, and maybe cause an old person to fall. 4 hours ago, I called the solicitor number that is present in the door, they said they will notify the owners. Tomorrow is Halloween, there are going to be allot of kids going around the neighbourhood, since this is all out in the open, I’m afraid for the children wellbeing - I already instructed my children not to get near anything that might look like hazardous.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Indus Road, Charlton
Report on FixMyStreet
